children: dipped 2.0% M/M in September to $1.79T due to the negative impact of markets, the company said Monday.
The decline was tempered by long-term net inflows of $6B.
On a Y/Y basis, AUM increased 7.8% from $1.66T at the end of September 2025.
Equity AUM fell to $763.4B from $775.2B at the end of August and rose from $686.2B a year ago.
Fixed income AUM of $427.6B dropped from $440.8B in the prior month and $438.7B a year ago.
